offers_products.reason: Main offering is park admission and experiences; food and merchandise sales are incidental to theme park visits.

offers_services.reason: Operates SeaWorld, Busch Gardens, Sesame Place parks delivering rides, shows and animal experiences to guests.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Families and individual guests buy tickets and passes to its theme parks.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Visitors are mainly individuals and families; group and school sales are a minor side.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is mostly single-visit tickets and in-park spending, though annual passes add some repeat buying.

cyclical_demand.reason: Theme park visits are discretionary entertainment that families can cut or postpone in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Park tickets and in-park spending are small, frequent-scale purchases for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Guests pay for rides, animal habitats and park attractions, which are assets rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are households and individual park visitors.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns 13 theme parks with coasters, rides and large animal habitats needing continual capital investment.
